vr1102b.title: Sony MZ-N10 Net MD Walkman Portable MiniDisc Recorder Silver Remote Cradle
vr1102b.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1102b.details: Sony MZ-N10 Net MD Walkman portable MiniDisc recorder in silver. Condition: there are some scratches and dirt from use, as shown in the photos. The battery was replaced with a new one. Operation was checked: charging on the cradle works, MD playback and sound output work, and the basic operations work. The unit was connected to a computer with the included general-purpose plug, and adding and deleting tracks with Net MD was confirmed. The basic operations of the remote control were checked: play, pause, stop, next track, previous track and volume. Included, as shown in the photos: the recorder, a remote control, a charging cradle, an AC adapter, a PC connection plug and a pouch. The cable between the cradle and a computer is not included; the plug can be used with a USB-C cable for the computer connection and for charging. Please see the photos for the exact condition and the included items.
vr1102b.why: A used Sony MZ-N10 Net MD Walkman portable MiniDisc recorder with a new battery, a remote control, a charging cradle and an AC adapter.
vr1102b.perfect: MiniDisc fans and collectors who want a Net MD Walkman with a new battery, a cradle and a remote control.
vr1102b.exp: A pre-owned Sony MZ-N10 Net MD recorder with the new battery, the accessories shown in the photos and the scratches described above.
vr1102b.cd: Pre-owned with some scratches and dirt from use, as shown in the photos. The battery was replaced with a new one. Includes the remote control, charging cradle, AC adapter, a PC connection plug and a pouch. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
